nodes.label: OSC Knowledge Assistant (README overview)
nodes.rationale: Operator-facing entry point: what the service is, how to run it, and the design decisions worth knowing. Switching any component is a profile edit, not a code change.

nodes.label: Quick Start
nodes.rationale: Requires PostgreSQL with pgvector and a running Ollama with qwen3:8b and nomic-embed-text pulled. Migrations run automatically on first use, so ingest is the first command. OSC_DATABASE__DSN points at a database other than the one in config/default.yaml.

nodes.label: Module Responsibility Map
nodes.rationale: protocols/types/registries/providers/ingestion/retrieval/generation/container/api, with the api layer explicitly described as thin — validate, delegate, encode. Restates the invariant: business logic depends only on protocols and types and never imports a provider, which is what makes providers swappable.

nodes.label: Ingestion Guarantees (idempotency and failure isolation)
nodes.rationale: Idempotent by content hash: re-running over an unchanged corpus makes zero embedding calls, an edited file re-indexes alone, a deleted file is pruned with its chunks. One bad file cannot break a sync — a corrupt or password-protected document is reported and skipped, the command exits non-zero, and crucially it is not pruned because a file that failed to parse is still present at the source. Scanned PDFs are rejected explicitly rather than indexed as empty; there is no OCR.

nodes.label: Supported Formats and Extraction
nodes.rationale: Markdown/text read byte-for-byte; HTML via the standard library with script/style discarded and title used; PDF via pypdf page by page with page count retained; Word via python-docx including table cells. PDF and Word need the `documents` extra. Adding a format is a function plus one dict entry in ingestion/parsers.py; nothing else changes.

nodes.label: Layered Configuration (env > .env > YAML profile)
nodes.rationale: Every value is addressable from the environment with the OSC_ prefix and a double underscore for nesting; the active YAML profile is overridable with OSC_PROFILE. This is the mechanism that makes provider swapping a configuration change rather than a code change.

nodes.label: Running an Experiment
nodes.rationale: Copy a profile, change one thing, point OSC_PROFILE at it. hosted-anthropic.yaml moves every component to a hosted vendor and is the only configuration with provider-verified citations; local-only.yaml swaps Ollama embeddings for in-process sentence-transformers and enables the cross-encoder reranker; groq-voyage.yaml shares no vendor with either. None requires a code change — this is the working proof of the vendor-agnosticism requirement.

nodes.label: Adding a Provider
nodes.rationale: Create a module that registers a factory with the relevant registry and add it to its package __init__. No existing file changes. The class only needs the shape of protocols.ChatModel — no base class to inherit, nothing to register elsewhere.

nodes.label: Working with a Reasoning Model
nodes.rationale: Qwen3 thinks before answering, spending completion tokens that never reach the user. Disabled by default because Ollama loads the model with a 4096-token context and reasoning competes with the answer for that budget. chunk_size, top_k and max_tokens are sized to the same window. If reasoning is re-enabled, raise max_tokens with it — an exhausted budget produces no answer text at all, and the adapter reports that explicitly rather than letting it become a silent 'I could not find anything'.

nodes.label: Interfaces (CLI, HTTP, UI)
nodes.rationale: CLI: serve/ingest/ask/search/providers. HTTP: GET /api/health reporting the active component set, POST /api/search as the retrieval-only debugging surface, POST /api/chat SSE by default. UI: a single static page at /, deliberately one file with no build step, consuming the same public API as any other client and expected to be replaced by a richer one.

nodes.label: Not Yet Built / Deployment Constraint
nodes.rationale: Authentication, per-document access control, rate limiting, conversation persistence, the evaluation harness and connectors beyond the filesystem are absent. Mitigating facts: the service exposes no write endpoint (ingestion is a CLI operation), and it must sit behind the corporate identity proxy until OIDC lands.
